# TopologyDrivenDynamics

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The principle that macroscopic dynamical properties (e.g., criticality) are emergent from microscopic graph topology rather than node-level parameters. Shifts design focus from individual neuron tuning to network structure, enabling scalable neuromorphic systems via topological engineering.
